fusions.name: Carving Slicer
fusions.desc: A crank slicer takes a cut from the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lid Off the Cooker
fusions.desc: Opens the valve on a pressure cooker, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mess Stove
fusions.desc: Sets down a field stove where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sealed Preserves
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
